analysis_spec.cells_remeasured_in_one_campaign: all four columns are re-timed for every capture inside this single campaign so own-vs-other contrasts are internally consistent; the scan-era identity/base cells are reported only as a Welch drift cross-check and never enter any verdict
analysis_spec.ci_crossing_zero_wording: compatible with zero; never proof of no effect
analysis_spec.common_static_sufficient: some base column c* has, in every row, paired delta T(c*)-T(own base) whose 95% CI lower bound is <= epsilon (not significantly worse beyond the practical margin in any row)
analysis_spec.cost_linkage: for significant row gains, break-even horizons are computed with the frozen batch estimator C_batch(k)=C_multi(capture)*moves_k/moves_base using measured migration costs from the frozen scan cost-benefit study; moves_k is the expert displacement between the two frozen maps
analysis_spec.equivalence_rule: only an interval wholly inside [-epsilon,+epsilon] supports practical equivalence; crossing zero alone does not
analysis_spec.estimand: T(capture, column) = mean over 4 independent starts of the 5-block mean completion_fenced_us_per_forward for that frozen layout on that capture
analysis_spec.no_selection: no best-start, repeat, prefix or subset selection; failed starts are retired, never retried under this frozen campaign
analysis_spec.paired_contrasts: within-capture start-level means of within-block paired differences: own-base-vs-identity and other-base-vs-own-base for both other columns
analysis_spec.row_tracks_own_base: both other-base-minus-own-base paired 95% CIs exclude zero positively
analysis_spec.scope_note: crosstab numbers are layer-replay completion times on one node with 8xH20, EP=8, DeepEP normal, DeepGEMM FP8; they are not server-side latencies and cannot replace the full-service three-arm validation
analysis_spec.tracking_room_supported: >=2 of the layer's 3 rows track their own base

candidate.applies_to: versus_captured_output and versus_identity_replay comparisons for every layout; identity comparisons are trivially exact against themselves

identity_versus_captured.strict_equivalence_note: enforced via max_abs_error <= atol on the identity-versus-captured comparison, which at rtol=0 is exactly equivalent to zero isclose failures under the strict bound

crosstab_study_spec.rows: three locked evaluation triggers per layer (real captured routes)

design.fresh_start_semantics: one torchrun process group per start; every start reloads all immutable artifacts and rebuilds weights before warmup
design.matrix: rows = three locked evaluation triggers per layer; columns = identity + frozen greedy base of each trigger reused verbatim across the layer; every cell timed in this one campaign
design.response_definition: start-level contrast T(a) - T(b) for two columns of the same capture = mean of the five paired block effects; each block effect is completion_fenced_us_per_forward(a) - completion_fenced_us_per_forward(b) within the same randomized block

timing.schedule_algorithm: random.Random(seed + block).shuffle over the frozen four-column order; every column is timed in every block
